# opnsense_captiveportal_template (Resource)

Custom captive portal page (**Services ▸ Captive Portal ▸ Templates**), used by `opnsense_captiveportal_zone.template`. OPNsense keeps only the files that differ from the default template, so `content` is not read back: changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_captiveportal_template" "guest" {
  name    = "guest"
  content = filebase64("${path.module}/guest-portal.zip")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) Base64-encoded ZIP of the template files (at least `index.html`), e.g. `filebase64("portal.zip")`. Start from the default template downloaded from the GUI.
- `name` (String) Template name, unique on the firewall.

### Read-Only

- `file_id` (String) Internal file ID of the template.
- `id` (String) UUID of the template.
